items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: But if you got Contreras fellas in the band, you never have a band.

ctx.x: That makes people happy and that makes your band. It's the best thing in the world to be with a bunch of man, everybody agreed at one point. But if you got Contreras fellas in the band, you never have a band. See?
